item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 15/Oct/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. It will be windy over the region. Besides, the area of low pressure now over the central part of the South China Sea will move towards the vicinity of Hainan Island and may develop gradually in the next couple of days. The associated rainbands will affect the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. A cold front is expected to reach southern China in the latter part of this week. Temperatures will fall over the region.
